That alias will capture all 16 corpus mentions and attach at least seven of them to the wrong bottle, in the wrong house, cloning the wrong original. RECOMMENDATION: per docs/CURATION.md's own rule — 'when in doubt, reject' — remove the bare 'Perseus' alias. Either drop the entry until the corpus disambiguates, or split it into two entries keyed on qualified aliases only ('Maison Alhambra Perseus', 'Alhambra Perseus', 'PDM Perseus'), leaving bare 'Perseus' unresolved. The corpus overwhelmingly uses the shorthand 'BR540' (12 occurrences) and '540' rather than the full name, and treats it as the single original that Zara Red Temptation, Al Haramain Amber Oud and Orientica Amber Rouge clone.
notes: SECOND-WORST TRAP FOR THE corpus_mentions METHOD, after 'sillage'. The word that distinguishes the Extrait from the EDP is 'extrait' — and 'extrait' appears in 39 corpus comments. A reviewer applying CURATION.md's arithmetic would read 39 as overwhelming evidence for the Extrait and move the canonical name. It is not: almost none of those 39 are about BR540. They are 'Electimuss Baroque Extrait', 'CDNIM EXTRAIT', 'an extrait de parfum' used as a concentration noun, and the Orientica 'extrait' on the bottle. Only one comment is plausibly about the BR540 Extrait ('I felt it was closer to the Extrait version') plus one adjacent ('the closest to the extrait'). The Extrait is real and does get discussed, but at roughly 2 mentions, not 39. The alias list is otherwise good; note that the committed alias 'Baccarat Rouge' is a prefix of 'Baccarat Rouge 540 Extrait de Parfum', so prefix-style matching would swallow the flanker.

notes: A flanker does exist and was not obvious: Mancera sells 'Intense Cedrat Boise' on its own storefront. Like Creed's 'Absolu Aventus', the qualifier is a PREFIX, so a suffix-only flanker check would miss it entirely. Mancera and Montale share a founder (Pierre Montale) and are routinely mixed up by commenters, so if a future corpus produces 'Montale Cedrat Boise' that is a misattribution of this bottle, not a new one. Lowest corpus count of the sixteen at 7 mentions, so it decides few edges either way.

notes: The bare word 'Explorer' is generic enough that it is worth keeping the two-word alias as the primary hook — 'explorer' unqualified could match a Jaguar or Ralph Lauren product in a broader corpus, and it is an ordinary English noun. Both flankers are real and current, so keep them recorded for the next corpus refresh.
